imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Scenic Waikiki beachfront panorama with palm trees, ocean water, and the Diamond Head crater in golden sunlight (waikiki-hero.dim_1200x400.png)
- Flat icon set of 7 transportation modes: bus, bicycle, trolley, car, rideshare, walking figure, scooter — in a warm coral and teal color palette (transport-icons.dim_512x128.png)

existing_features.title: Build a frontend transportation guide that displays all Waikiki/Oahu transportation options. Each section should show the transport type, pricing information, and practical tips for tourists. Include a clear navigation or filtering mechanism to browse categories.

Apply a warm, tropical visual theme inspired by Hawaii — using sandy, ocean, and sunset tones (e.g., warm coral, sandy beige, ocean teal). Use a clean, airy layout with bold section headers and friendly typography that feels welcoming to tourists. Apply the theme consistently across all UI components.
Generate and display a hero banner image at the top of the guide featuring a scenic Waikiki beach and cityscape with a tropical, sun-drenched atmosphere to set the visual tone of the app.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create a backend that stores transportation guide data for Waikiki/Oahu, including sections for: TheBus, Biki bike share, trolleys, rideshares (Uber/Lyft), car rentals, walking, and other local transport options. Each entry should have a title, description, pricing info, and practical tips.
